raw_response:
I am 67, I have farmed these 15 mu in Quzhou for 45 years. I never went to school, not one day. My mother-in-law taught me how to hold a hoe when I was young, and I learned the rest by watching whose field looks heavy at harvest. Old Wang across the lane, his wheat is always thick and his heads are big, so I do what he does. If it worked last year, I do it again. Change is dangerous.

My land is split the same as always: 8 mu for wheat then maize, that is my rice bowl. 4 mu cotton for cash. 2 mu peanut for oil and selling. 1 mu mungbean, quick and easy, and my daughter-in-law likes the soup.

The wheat is already in the ground from last October. I sowed improved seed, 15 jin per mu. Before sowing I ploughed deep and put one full bag of compound fertilizer per mu — the 15-15-15 kind, 100 jin a bag. At green-up now I will topdress with half a bag of urea per mu, that is 50 jin. At heading I will spread another 30 jin of urea per mu. I know it is a lot, but three years ago I tried to save 20 yuan per mu on urea and the heads came out small. I lost much more than I saved. Never again. I water four times from my well: once now if the land is dry, once at jointing, once when it flowers, and once when the grain fills. I spray twice: herbicide when the wheat is small, and one insecticide before the bugs eat the flag leaf. I expect 1000 jin per mu, that is 500 kilos, if the weather is fair.

After wheat comes off in June, I have no time to waste. I rotary till quick and plant hybrid maize seed the same day or next day. If I am late, the frost gets it. I put one bag of compound fertilizer per mu, 100 jin, same as wheat. At big trumpet stage I topdress with 60 jin urea per mu. I water three times: jointing, tasseling, and filling. Two sprays: herbicide at the start, then one for corn borer. Last year I got 1200 jin per mu, that is 600 kilos.

For cotton on 4 mu: I plough in April and plant hybrid cotton. One bag of compound per mu, 100 jin. Topdress urea twice: 40 jin at squaring, 30 jin at flowering. Cotton needs water but hates wet feet, so I water three times carefully. Five sprays at least. Bollworm is the devil. If I see one worm, I spray immediately. I hope for 560 jin of seed cotton per mu, that is 280 kilos.

Peanut on 2 mu: I rotary till and plant seed I saved from last year. I put 80 jin compound fertilizer per mu. Peanut does not need as much nitrogen as grain, so I only give one light topdress of 10 jin urea per mu when the flowers are thick. Water twice. Three sprays for leaf spot and bugs. Should get 700 jin pods per mu, that is 350 kilos.

Mungbean on 1 mu: Rotary till, plant saved seed. I spread 40 jin compound fertilizer per mu. Water once if dry. Spray twice for bugs. Hope for 200 jin per mu, that is 100 kilos.

Everything costs money. A bag of compound is more than 100 yuan now, urea is up too. I have three mouths at home. I must be careful. But I would rather spend on fertilizer than risk a bad harvest. A bad year means borrowing money and losing face. Wasting some fertilizer just means less profit, not an empty stomach. Old Wang buys the same amounts, so I know I am not wrong.
